title: Stochastic Cahn--Hilliard Equations from One-Dimensional Ising--Kac--Kawasaki Dynamics
summary: This paper investigates the scaling limit of the one-dimensional lattice Ising--Kac--Kawasaki dynamics near the critical temperature. Starting from a martingale formulation for the Kac coarse-grained field, we decompose the microscopic dynamics into a discrete conservative drift and a pure-jump Dynkin martingale. Under a critical scaling regime, the nonlinear drift is identified via a conservative multiscale replacement scheme based on the second-order Boltzmann--Gibbs Principle, yielding the cubic conservative term.
